description: This file contains Perl scripts that generate ARMv8 assembly code for Montgomery multiplication, squaring, and reduction routines used in cryptographic computations, specifically for BoringSSL/OpenSSL. It includes functions for modular multiplication and squaring optimized for ARMv8 architecture, with detailed inline assembly for performance-critical operations.

methods.name: bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Perl script generating ARMv8 assembly for Montgomery multiplication routine.

methods.name: bn_sqr8x_mont
methods.description: Perl script generating ARMv8 assembly for optimized squaring routine.

methods.name: bn_mul4x_mont
methods.description: Perl script generating ARMv8 assembly for 4x Montgomery multiplication with reduction.
